_comment: Everything about the App Store listing that is not prose. The prose is in en-US/. scripts/wire-appstore.py writes all of this; price and availability need --set-price, which is Kelly's call.
_categories: Card and Board are subcategories of Games, not categories of their own.
_review_contact: The App Review contact's name, phone and email are in ~/.thecardplace-keys/review-contact.json, not here: this repository is public.

age_rating._comment: No wagering anywhere, so not simulated gambling. All None gives 4+.

accessibility._comment: Claimed only where it has been built and checked. Voice Control is left off until somebody has played a whole game of each by voice. There is no video or audio content, so captions and audio descriptions do not apply.

price._comment: Applied only with --set-price. Free, in every territory.
